meaning:
ἀνα-βιβάζω
(causal of ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi., also for רָכַב hi., etc. ;]
to make go up, draw up, as a ship (Xen.): σαγήνην, Mat.13:48 (metaphorically, MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: which, when it was filled, they drew up on the beach. They sat down, and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.
